meta.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA): Weekly Heating Oil and Propane Prices, residential propane, U.S. monthly average (dollars per gallon, excluding taxes); EIA Energy Explained, British thermal units (Btu): 1 gallon of propane = 91,452 Btu
meta.notes: Kept apart from energy-prices.json because that file is regenerated by scripts/fetch-sources.mjs. EIA collects residential propane prices weekly in the heating season (October to March) and once a month from April to September; the value used is the latest full monthly U.S. average when checked (October 2026, release of 11/12/2026). Prices exclude taxes, and propane is priced locally, so the calculators label it assumed and let you type your own.

us.source: EIA, Weekly Heating Oil and Propane Prices, Residential Propane, U.S., Oct-26 monthly: 2.659 dollars per gallon excluding taxes (checked 2026-11-14; weekly values 10/05/26 to 11/09/26: 2.586 to 2.826)

btuPerGallon.source: EIA Energy Explained, British thermal units (Btu): "Propane 1 gallon=91,452 Btu" (checked 2026-11-14)
